383:t_3:28.en:
$n
「...I don't know what I should do yet.」

383:t_3:29.en:
$n
「But I'll rescue Miss $$スズネ$$, whatever it takes.」

383:t_3:30.en:
$$シン$$
「It looks like you've found your answer.」

383:t_3:31.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Shooting or being shot comes second. We wanted to hear your resolve.」

383:t_3:32.en:
$n
「Is that what you two did too?」

383:t_3:33.en:
$$シン$$
「Yeah. We were lucky enough to get help and pull through.」

383:t_3:34.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's why we wanted you to make up your mind too. Now we can give you our full support.」

383:t_3:35.en:
$$竜馬$$
「No... We can't leave rescuing Miss $$スズネ$$ to $n alone.」

383:t_3:36.en:
$$甲児$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is the $$ボランティア部$$'s darling, after all.」

383:t_3:37.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$ワッ太$$, $$正太郎$$, $$アマタ$$ and the others will get fired up too if we're rescuing Miss $$スズネ$$.」

383:t_3:38.en:
$n
「Then we'll do it with everyone's help, no matter what tactics $$バルビエル$$ uses.」

383:t_3:39.en:
$$ティティ$$
「This is getting fun! Do your best, everyone!」

383:t_3:40.en:
$n
(I won't cling to convenient hopes or let despair make me reckless. I'll do what I have to do...)

383:t_3:41.en:
$n
(Miss $$スズネ$$... For me, that means rescuing you.)

383:t_3:45.en: ～Inside the Imperial Capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$～

383:t_3:46.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...That concludes $$バルビエル$$'s report.」

383:t_3:48.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「It's better to have more options.」

383:t_3:49.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「So it ends in a direct confrontation...」

383:t_3:52.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「What do you think, $$ストラウス$$?」

383:t_3:54.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Your interest already lies elsewhere...」

383:t_3:56.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「You have permission to sortie. But don't go too far.」

383:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Do you feel sorry for $$ギルター$$?」

383:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand that what you feel isn't mere pity, $$セツコ$$.」

383:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your sorrow produced 50 Z in $$Ｚチップ$$s... I'll add them to the squad's stock.」

383:t_10:10.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I wanted to know the root of the hatred inside $$バルビエル$$...」

383:t_10:11.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But if I learn that, I may not be able to fight him...」

383:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There's no point debating possibilities. We'll deal with that when it happens.」

383:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Perhaps that bastard... will destroy himself without you having to do anything, $$セツコ$$.」

383:t_10:14.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. I feel a little better now.」

383:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm glad my off-the-cuff advice was useful.」

383:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Sorrow and hatred, $$セツコ$$ and $$バルビエル$$... What exactly makes these two $$スフィア$$s so incompatible...?)

383:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
($n should now be able to draw out 100% of $$ジェミニオン$$'s current power, even without Miss $$スズネ$$.)

383:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(With that, I have no more doubts. I'll bet every last one of my $$Ｚチップ$$s on $n...)

383:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...And once you've made up your mind, all that's left is to do it! Let's give it our all today... Business, business!」

384:t_000:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「The $$ターミナル・ベース$$ is within combat range.」

384:t_000:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「To all units. There are no changes to the operation previously announced.」

384:t_000:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「Resistance members, protect the city's residents and guide their evacuation while we engage the enemy interception force.」

384:t_000:4.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「We're counting on you to deal with $$サイデリアル$$, $c!」

384:t_000:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Of course. This is the big one. Take this base, and the fighting in the northern $$中央大陸$$ is pretty much decided.」

384:t_000:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$タケル$$... I'm counting on you to look after $n.」

384:t_000:9.en:
$n
「I won't hold you back. I'm counting on you, $$タケル$$.」

384:t_000:11.en:
$$カレン$$
「So $$タケル$$ and $n are teaming up.」

384:t_000:12.en:
$$ノノ$$
「A classic handsome super robot pilot and a cool guy with a slightly dark side! I'm fired up!」

384:t_000:13.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「No, no, $$ノノ$$! He looks like a cool guy with a dark side, but he's really a clueless dimwit who can't read the room!」

384:t_000:17.en:
$$タケル$$
「Still, I'm surprised you were the one who asked to team up, $n.」

384:t_000:18.en:
$n
「I felt it instinctively when we fought the army of darkness the other day...」

384:t_000:19.en:
$n
「I need your power to break through the wall I'm feeling.」

384:t_000:20.en:
$$タケル$$
「I see... I'll do the best I can.」

384:t_000:21.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, be careful. The interception force has emerged.」

384:t_001:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「That machine... Is it $$ギルター$$!?」

384:t_001:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「He's come out alone? So he's finally made up his mind!」

384:t_001:2.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Be careful! Knowing that man... I suspect he's prepared some sort of scheme!」

384:t_001:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Heh heh heh...! That's right, $c!」

384:t_001:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「All the bitter humiliation you've put me through...! I'll pay you back double... No, tenfold!」

384:t_001:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's the typical exaggeration of a third-rate fool.」

384:t_001:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「I'm sick of your face! Let's finish this already!」

384:t_001:7.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Let's see if you stay so confident after seeing this!」

384:t_002:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What the hell is that!?」

384:t_002:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The scorpion's venom...! It's the same as $$バルビエル$$'s!」

384:t_002:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Exactly! Their hypnotic radio waves strip humans of reason and turn them into ferocious beasts!」
